title: Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba, the Great Captain -> secretary Miguel Perez de Almazan, letter in cipher
correspondents: Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba, the Great Captain -> secretary Miguel Perez de Almazan
shelfmark: Real Academia de la Historia (Madrid), Coleccion Salazar y Castro, A-12, f. 1 (inventory no. 1272)
folio_note: f. 1; catalogue says: letter in cipher
status: Listed in the RAH Salazar y Castro catalogue (IA full text) as cipher with no decipherment or translation noted in the entry. Volume A-12 is not among the Salazar volumes on DECODE (only 9/8, 9/17, 9/23-9/31, 9/34 appear). Ferdinand's secretariat: the Catholic Monarchs' cifra general (known from Galende Diaz 1994, Parisi 2020 and the esp318/garcilaso1498 targets in this repo) may apply.
why: Ferdinand the Catholic's own or ambassadors' cipher correspondence, Italian wars and the Great Captain
